programs.title: The Pioneer Woman
programs.desc: Ree Drummond puts together a quick and easy ranch-style cookout; she makes Caribbean Burgers with mango slaw for a taste of the islands in Oklahoma, and her Sunshine Pasta Salad and lemon mustard dressing is a colorful side dish.

programs.title: The Pioneer Woman
programs.desc: Ree Drummond gets grilling with herby grilled shrimp and scallop skewers along with savory grilled steak skewers; she prepares charred broccoli and cauliflower salad, grilled Yukon gold potatoes and coconut cream icebox pie with grilled pineapple.

programs.title: The Kitchen
programs.desc: Grilling up the summer's best recipes, including grilled tomatoes with scallions, chives and ricotta and grilled corn and farro salad; "Cakealikes" judge Kalen Allen stops by to share his opinions on the season's grilling trends.

programs.title: Ready Jet Cook
programs.desc: Chef Jet Tila makes two Chinese-American icons from scratch: Beef & Broccoli and Sesame Chicken. He shares professional wok tips, velveting techniques, and the salty-sweet flavors that turned these restaurant favorites into at-home essentials.

programs.title: Ready Jet Cook
programs.desc: Chef Jet Tila recreates two Chinese takeout favorites at home: Yang Chow Fried Rice and Kung Pao Chicken. From market shopping to wok skills and velveting techniques, Jet shows how easy it is to turn these classic, craveable dishes into weeknight staples.

programs.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programs.desc: Guy Fieri's doubling up with sweet and savory, both hot and cold; there are chicken and steak arepas in San Juan, Puerto Rico, winning wings from a food truck in Laramie, Wyo., and an ice cream-cake combo; a raclette-ramen mashup in Cleveland.
